candidates.title: Move sign-in after pet choice
candidates.change: Shift account sign-in to occur right after picking or building a pet, so users build emotional attachment before account creation.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently happens before pet selection, causing drop-off; adoption step conversion is low at 60.9%.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in after pet choice within onboarding is permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in after pet choice leverages emotional investment to fix adoption drop-off.

candidates.title: Add desktop controls walkthrough screen
candidates.change: Insert a short interactive guide screen before finishing that demonstrates hotkeys, hiding, and dragging your pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your desktop pet is ready!
home_intro.body: Use hotkeys or click your pet on the desktop anytime to summon or hide them.

components.text: If pet doesn't appear, check desktop display permission settings.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by 8 support emails with a simple low-cost hint.

candidates.title: Display notification toggle during generation wait

candidates.score_note: Reduces drop-off during long generation waits at the finish stage.

candidates.why: 76.2% conversion on choose_path can be improved by providing side-by-side visual clarity.

guard.reason: Split layout for choose_path maintains both adoption options.

candidates.score_note: Split layout visual comparison clarifies choose_path options.

candidates.title: Photo requirement guidance tips

guard.reason: Photo selection guidance tips improve upload_photos without violating rules.
